name: wp-soli-oidc-client-plugin
description: OIDC client plugin for WordPress sites consuming the Soli Laravel provider

scripts.i18n:build: npm run i18n:make-pot && npm run i18n:make-mo
scripts.i18n:make-pot: wp-env run cli wp i18n make-pot wp-content/plugins/wp-soli-oidc-client-plugin wp-content/plugins/wp-soli-oidc-client-plugin/languages/soli-oidc-client.pot
scripts.i18n:make-mo: wp-env run cli wp i18n make-mo wp-content/plugins/wp-soli-oidc-client-plugin/languages/

wordpress._comment: Oldest supported WordPress branch. The e2e suite runs against the newest patch of this branch as well as the newest release, and the release workflows stamp it into the plugin's 'requires'. Raise it when production no longer runs it.

author: Joran Out
